verdict.rationale: GitLab's first-party docs list an "SSH keys" topic alongside Git version-control documentation, which points to a native SSH-key capability. The evidence is only a bare navigation label, with no detail on registering keys on an account or using them to authenticate Git operations. Missing for 10: documented steps for adding SSH keys to a user account, explicit confirmation that SSH keys authenticate Git push/pull, details on supported key types or management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register SSH keys on my account to authenticate Git operations

citations.quote: Work with the Git version control system.
